synthetic.limitation: Gaussian approximation does not capture non-Gaussian marginals, heavy tails, or non-linear dependencies in neural data.

shuffled.description: Brain representations permuted across trials within each split. Trial-specific EEG-iEEG correspondence is destroyed. Marginal feature distribution is preserved exactly.
shuffled.limitation: Shuffling within splits preserves the within-split marginal distribution exactly, but does not match any cross-trial structure. Cannot establish that benefit is task-specific vs. generic structure.

random.note: This is the weakest control: pure Gaussian noise at unit scale. Acts as a reference for whether any structured representation helps.
